description: Inspect a four-, six- or eight-digit HTS classification and its complete indented descendants, including unnamed superior rows. Published section titles are retained separately in sections, outside legal ancestry. Ancestry is built from the whole containing heading before filtering. Each parent and inherited-rate source has an exact nodeId follow-up. Chapters 98 and 99 preserve published forest roots without inventing four-digit records.

code.description: Four-, six- or eight-digit HTS code, bare or conventionally dotted.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same tool with identical arguments.

limit.description: Requested items as a positive safe integer; effectiveLimit discloses clamping to at most 100, and pages may be byte limited. Keep the same requested limit for continuation.

nodeId.description: Exact returned node identifier within this classification subtree; omit to browse.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_code`: Code is not a supported four-, six- or eight-digit identifier. `invalid_cursor`: Cursor arguments or node selection do not match this heading. `cursor_expired`: Saved source snapshot or selected edition expired. `release_changed`: Edition changed twice during source assembly. `invalid_hierarchy`: Complete source rows cannot establish safe ancestry. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
